labels.label: Sales performance Calls, deals won and lost, value won and new leads by day, week or month, against the period before.
Sales pipeline Leads and value at each stage
Won and lost deals Deals closed in the period, with the last note
Attempts before a win How many calls it took to win or get paid
Never called Open contacts nobody has called yet
Deal flow by stage Deals entering each stage, how long they stay, how many move on and how many are stuck.
Payments received Money collected and promises made by day, week or month, against the period before.
Money owed by lateness What each customer owes and how late it is
Promises to pay Pending promises, and those kept or broken in the period
Payments received Payments by day and by customer
